title: Best Deep Learning Engineers (2026): Neural Networks for Real Tasks
description: How to hire a deep learning engineer for neural network models in vision, audio, text or forecasting: data, compute, evaluation, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Deep learning engineers build and train neural networks for complex tasks: recognizing images, understanding audio, processing text, forecasting or generating content. Deep learning can achieve strong results, but it needs good data, computing power and careful evaluation. Projects go wrong when simpler methods would work, training data is poor, compute costs are ignored, or models are not tested on real cases. This guide helps you decide if deep learning fits and hire well.
